messages:
jordan: Quick thread: UX nits from last compliance pass. Two small but important things: (A) the encryption/state pill copy is leading to support questions, and (B) the audit log timestamp column is confusing when you change timezone in the console. Can we tidy both?

rachel: Re: pill copy, users expect the pill to answer "who holds the key" at a glance. Current text 'Managed key - Redwood' gets misread. Proposals: 'Key owner: Redwood', 'Key owner: Customer (BYOK)', or a paired label+subtext like:
- Key owner: Redwood
  Who holds the master key for stored data
I prefer the paired label for clarity, but worried about density.

harry: For audit log timestamps: when I toggle the timezone dropdown to 'Local' the column shows offset but the header still says UTC. We should either convert timestamps or show a suffix like '2025-05-12 14:23 (UTC-7)'. Left as-is is causing support tickets.

jordan: Good catch. UX asks: do we show timezone in header or in each row? Ops prefers header-level because row-level adds clutter and makes copy/paste messy for exports. Suggestion: show header 'Timestamp (your timezone)' and a tooltip with exact offset and a 'view in UTC' link.

rachel: Also Accessibility: the encryption pill is rendered as a button for changing ownership. Small text on the pill has contrast ~3.6:1 on hover. Need >=4.5:1 for small text per WCAG. Either increase font weight or darken background. Also ensure the pill focus ring is 3px solid and visible with high contrast.

harry: For copy variants I mocked in the component doc: 'Key ownership 145; Redwood-managed' vs 'Key ownership 145; Customer-managed (BYOK)'. Alternatively a compact two-line microcopy: first line owner, second line small 'Who can revoke or rotate keys'. Thoughts?

jordan: I like compact two-line microcopy for screen readability, but in list views we only have horizontal space for one line. So we need a single-line fallback that is audit-friendly. Proposal: primary pill text: 'Key owner: Redwood' and aria-describedby pointing to a hidden explanatory element with 'Who can revoke and rotate the key for stored blobs.' Also include a help icon that opens accessible tooltip + link to docs.

dev-bot: Automated check: color contrast on current pill hover fails (3.6) in latest build. Also flagged missing aria-describedby on pill.

ops-bot: From support: include data attribute data-key-owner="redwood|customer" on the settings row for easier triage. Ensure it's not logged with key ids. Retention policy: keep for 60 days.

rachel: UX nit for mobile: in narrow widths the pill wraps and hides the help icon. Suggest we hide the help icon and expose an inline 'Learn more' link below the setting on small screens.

harry: I'll PR two changes: (1) update pill styles to meet contrast + focus ring, (2) add aria-describedby and visually-hidden explanatory text, (3) header change for audit log: 'Timestamp (Local)' with tooltip showing offset and a toggle to 'Show UTC'. Will add screenshots.

jordan: Perfect. Follow ups: harry add measurements for contrast and a11y test notes; rachel update component README with copy options and mobile fallback; ops please confirm retention of data-key-owner flag. Closing after PR review. Thanks! :rocket:
